quest.title: Go Forth, Golden Whirlwind!
quest.description: You have received no commissions from Katheryne, nor do you have appointments with any friends. And yet, in the darkness, a golden light leads you to a small island in the middle of the ocean. How strange. What in the world happened?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: Might I ask for your name?

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: Good, I've written it down. May I ask if you are willing to put your honor as a warrior on the line?

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Mm? Are you not, then, a warrior who has come forth to take part in this contest?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Never heard of such a thing.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Have you not heard of the "Clash of Lone Blades"?

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: That can't be, I should have put up notices.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where did you put them up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, that's no use at all! No one's gonna see that, much less come over!

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Hmph! This is all the Yashiro Commission's fault, what with their "no weapons or fighting during the Irodori Festival" nonsense. I applied to organize duels on Ritou, but they refused, and wouldn't let me put up advertisements, either.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: So I could only put the arena here and place the sign nearby.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: That said, we have already had 4 applicants. If we also include you, that makes 5.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh, so people actually joined. That's odd. Speaking of which, Paimon can't quite remember why you came here either, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: The way I see it, you were able to find this place without any prior hints. This must mean that you are a warrior with a formidable spirit indeed.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Those who hanker after martial prowess will always be attracted to one another. This is the way of the world — and there is little need to be surprised by it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon has no idea what world you live in.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Hehe. But still, would you be willing to take part?

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: If you can defeat each of the four challengers, you will receive a reward, as a matter of course.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: Well then, please do take your time.

choices.text: Oh, no, no, have a nice day.
